system.description: You can sort your HUD's Inventory by item value. The actual gold value is not displayed.

upgrades.description: Your Inventory is tabbed to sort your items by type, and it includes a history tab that tracks your item usage and any former owners of an item.
You can determine what type of loot box the item would have come from.
Whenever you add a new item to your Inventory, the gold value of that item is displayed.

system.limitations: Ranks in this Skill only increase by magical means.
